t: This is Queen Charlotte's and Chelsea Hospital, one of the oldest maternity hospitals in Europe, founded in 1739. It stands between East Acton and White City, next to Hammersmith Hospital, having moved here in October 2000. The name honours Charlotte of Mecklenburg-Strelitz, wife of George III and Britain's longest-serving queen consort. Plenty of people were born here. Among them are the actress Deborah Watling, who played Victoria in Doctor Who, the table tennis players Diane and Rosalind Rowe, the critic John Gross, and the mathematician Antonia Jones.
